section_summary.extract_value: The section describes a single cross-sectional study that used a non-probabilistic convenience sampling technique. Sample size was calculated using a rule of 5–10 participants per instrument item based on the IES-2 (23 items), yielding a minimum sample range of 115–230 individuals; the authors also state they considered minimum sample size per subgroup (women and men) to examine sex differences.
section_summary.evidence_source: This study used a cross-sectional design with a non-probabilistic convenience sampling technique. Considering that IES-2 is the longer of the two scales analysed here (23 items), we used it as the basis for our sampling calculation. Thus, the minimum sample should meet a ratio of 115–230 individuals. In addition, because we wished to examine sex differences, the minimum sample size was considered per sub-group (women and men).
